title: Billing and Coding: Wireless Capsule Endoscopy

covered.1: Covered if criteria are met for 91110. If the procedure is performed for a covered diagnosis in Group 1 but the study cannot be completed in a circumstance where the capsule is unable to pass the pyloric junction, the incomplete study should be billed as CPT ® 91111 with a Group 1 ICD-10 code.
covered.2: CPT ® 91111 should be billed with a Group 2 ICD-10 code when the purpose of the study is to examine only the esophagus to the level of the gastroesophageal junction.
